title: Deposits.
bodyText: Except as expressly authorized by this chapter or by federal law, no person shall solicit, accept, or hold deposits in this State.
bodyHtml: §412:1-105  Deposits.  Except as expressly authorized by this chapter or by federal law, no person shall solicit, accept, or hold deposits in this State. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1; am L 2002, c 40, §11]
